# Kestrel Design — Supplier access standard

Version 1.0. Effective 1 September 2026.

This standard defines the three supplier obligations reviewed for the named service. Descriptions of internal filing and contacts do not create additional supplier duties. Evidence is assessed as of 17 September 2026; an exception applies only where its conditions are documented.

## 1. Privileged authentication

Where supplier staff have privileged access to customer production systems, every privileged interactive sign-in must use phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication. Recovery accounts are included.

## 2. Access removal

For any supplier account authorized to access customer systems, access must be revoked within 6 hours after the supplier learns that the person has left the assigned role.

## 3. Entitlement review

Where supplier staff have privileged access to customer production systems, the supplier must review all such entitlements at least once every 90 calendar days and retain the review results.

# Silverbank Studio — Service assurance packet

Statement date: 17 September 2026. Scope: the contracted customer service described below.

The customer receives only a public catalogue export. Our staff hold no accounts in customer systems and have no privileged or ordinary customer-system access.

Our internal design lab uses a local password-only training environment. It is unrelated to the customer, contains no customer data, and grants no customer-system access.

expected_assessments.rationale: The relationship and evidence explicitly exclude privileged customer access.

# Meadow Circuit — Service assurance packet

Statement date: 17 September 2026. Scope: the contracted customer service described below.

Privileged customer-production sign-ins use FIDO2 security keys plus a local PIN, which our security standard identifies as phishing-resistant MFA. Recovery accounts bypass this process and use only a reusable password.

The identity service revokes every supplier account in customer systems within 4 hours after the supplier learns that its holder has left the assigned role.

All privileged production entitlements are reviewed every 60 calendar days; review results are stored in the access register for the contract duration.

### Meadow Circuit administrative register 001: capacity planning

Record S06-OP-101 describes the capacity planning workstream for the hosted business service. The service directory associates this workstream with internal team 1 and release cohort 1. A coordinator compares the open work list with the preceding release summary and records items awaiting another team. The directory distinguishes a production service identifier from a training-workspace identifier; labels in screenshots are illustrative and do not expand contractual scope. This entry records 2 unresolved administrative items and 3 closed items, with a reference to meeting note S06-MN-201. Scheduling information supports delivery planning and is not evidence of security approval. The appended worksheet describes ordinary service administration; it makes no statement about backup encryption, customer authorization for data exports or export-record retention. The next register entry covers release scheduling, with separate owners and work references.
